# AI Chauffeur · full

> Answers every call. Quotes your rates. Books the trip.

AI Chauffeur is the AI reservation desk for limousine, black car and chauffeured transportation companies. It answers in your company's name, quotes from your rate sheet and books the reservation: flight number, meet and greet, passengers, bags, child seats, gate codes. With your reservation software (the $1,697 plan), it writes the booking straight in. Changes and cancellations go to your dispatcher. It does not dispatch. Flight tracking and more languages can be added to any plan.

Last reviewed: 2026-10-20

## What it does

- Answers every call in your company name.
- Takes the whole reservation: airport, hourly, point to point, extra stops, meet and greet or curbside, sedan to 56-passenger coach.
- Quotes from your rate sheet, by vehicle and time of day, in your service area. A trip your rates don't cover goes to your dispatcher to quote.
- Reads the trip back and books it.
- Right after the call, your dispatcher has the trip sheet, the recording and the transcript. Your passenger is booked.
- Your dispatcher assigns the car and the chauffeur. Dispatch, changes and cancellations stay with your team.
- [What it does](https://aichauffeur.ai/what-it-does/): AI Chauffeur answers the phones for limo and black car companies, quotes your rates, books the trip, and sends the trip sheet to your dispatcher.
- [What it can do for your company](https://aichauffeur.ai/what-it-can-do/): Live transfer, repeat callers by name, account lookup, your reservation software, more than 50 languages, a second brand.

## Pricing

- [Pricing](https://aichauffeur.ai/pricing/): Two plans. Everything on the list.
- AI Chauffeur is $997 a month plus a $997 one-time setup. With your reservation software, it's $1,697 a month plus a $1,697 one-time setup.
- Month to month. No contract.
- The monthly price is the same for 3 cars or 300.
- Everything in AI Chauffeur, plus:
- Writes the trip straight into your reservation software
- Remembers your regular customers
- A card link when there's no card on file
- Add-ons, priced on a quote: more than 50 languages, flight tracking, reminder texts, a talk button for your website.
- Answers 24/7, only after hours, or only the calls your office misses. You pick.
- If we can't connect your software within 30 days, you get a full refund within 10 days.
- Built for one company: yours. Your name on the line, your fleet, your rates, your service area. Not a $99 bot with your name typed in.

## Answers

- [Can it pick the right vehicle for the number of bags?](https://aichauffeur.ai/answers/can-it-pick-the-right-vehicle-for-the-number-of-bags/): Yes. AI Chauffeur picks the vehicle from your own fleet list that fits the passengers and the bags. If nothing fits, it flags the trip for dispatch.
- [Does it answer the phone at 3 AM?](https://aichauffeur.ai/answers/does-it-answer-the-phone-at-3-am/): Yes. AI Chauffeur answers every call in your company name, quotes from your rate sheet and books the trip, at 3 AM the same as at 3 PM.
- [Does it quote prices?](https://aichauffeur.ai/answers/does-it-quote-prices/): Yes. Set up for your company, AI Chauffeur quotes from your rate sheet, by vehicle and time of day, in your service area. A trip your rates don't cover goes to your dispatcher to quote.
- [Does it work with my booking software?](https://aichauffeur.ai/answers/does-it-work-with-my-booking-software/): Yes. It works with Limo Anywhere, FASTTRAK, Moovs, Livery Coach, GNet, Hudson, SantaCruz (GroundWidgets), LimoExpress, A to Z Dispatch and RideBits. Connected at setup.
- [Does the caller know they're talking to a computer?](https://aichauffeur.ai/answers/does-the-caller-know-theyre-talking-to-a-computer/): The name says what it is. AI Chauffeur answers in your company name, books the trip, and puts the caller through to your team when they ask for a person.
- [How fast is a booking call?](https://aichauffeur.ai/answers/how-fast-is-a-booking-call/): As fast as the caller. AI Chauffeur keeps what the caller says first, asks only for what is missing, quotes from your rate sheet and books the trip.
- [What does dispatch actually get after a call?](https://aichauffeur.ai/answers/what-does-dispatch-actually-get-after-a-call/): Right after the call, your dispatcher has the trip sheet, the recording and the transcript. A call about a trip already booked is sent to dispatch as a message right away.
- [What happens if it doesn't understand a name or an address?](https://aichauffeur.ai/answers/what-happens-if-it-doesnt-understand-a-name-or-an-address/): It asks once more. If the name or address is still unclear, AI Chauffeur flags it for dispatch instead of guessing, and the recording comes along.
- [What happens when a caller wants to change or cancel a trip?](https://aichauffeur.ai/answers/what-happens-when-a-caller-wants-to-change-or-cancel-a-trip/): AI Chauffeur takes the message and sends it to dispatch right away. It never changes or cancels a trip itself. Your team makes the change.
- [What if the caller has a question it can't answer?](https://aichauffeur.ai/answers/what-if-the-caller-has-a-question-it-cant-answer/): It does not guess. AI Chauffeur puts the caller through to your team, and a price that is not on your rate sheet is flagged for dispatch, never made up.
- [Can it handle airport pickups with flight numbers?](https://aichauffeur.ai/answers/can-it-handle-airport-pickups-with-flight-numbers/): Yes. AI Chauffeur takes the whole airport pickup, flight number included, and the flight number goes on the trip sheet for dispatch.

## Pricing questions

- Is there a contract? No. Month to month.
- What does the setup fee cover? Building it for your company: your name, your service area, your fleet, your rates and who gets the trip sheet.
- Does it quote my rates? Yes. Set up for your company, it quotes from your rate sheet, by vehicle and time of day, in your service area. A trip your rates don't cover goes to your dispatcher to quote.
- Does it work with my reservation software? Yes. It works with Limo Anywhere, FASTTRAK, Moovs, Livery Coach, GNet, Hudson, SantaCruz (GroundWidgets), LimoExpress, A to Z Dispatch and RideBits. With your reservation software, the trip is written straight into your software.
- How much is AI Chauffeur with my reservation software? $1,697 a month plus a $1,697 one-time setup. It writes the trip straight into your reservation software, remembers your regular customers, and sends a card link when there's no card on file.
- Do I pay for talk time? Yes. Talk time is 65 cents a minute from the first minute, on every plan. No plan comes with free minutes.
- Does the price go up for a bigger fleet? No. The monthly price is the same for 3 cars or 300. A bigger fleet just uses more talk time.
- What if you can't connect my software? If we can't connect your software within 30 days, you get a full refund within 10 days.
- Does it track flights? Yes, as an add-on. It takes the flight number on the call, and flight tracking watches the flight for your dispatcher. Priced on a quote.
- What add-ons can I get? More than 50 languages, flight tracking, reminder texts, and a talk button for your website. Each one is priced on a quote.
- Can it answer only after hours, or only the calls we miss? Yes. 24/7, only after hours, or only the calls your office misses. You pick.
- Is it set up for my company? Yes. We build it for your company: your name on the line, your fleet, your rates, your service area. Not a bot with your name typed in.
- What does my dispatcher get after a call? Right after the call: the trip sheet, the recording and the transcript. Your dispatcher assigns the car and the chauffeur.

## Questions operators actually ask

- Is this just basic call coverage? No. AI Chauffeur answers your phones and books the trips. It takes the whole trip, quotes your rates, and sends the trip sheet to your dispatcher.
- Does it replace my dispatcher? No. It takes the phones so your dispatcher is not buried by missed calls and repeated questions. Your people run the cars, and your dispatcher still runs the operation. Which half of the job gets automated, and which half never will, is set out on limo dispatch automation.
- What still requires dispatcher approval? Assigning the car and the chauffeur. AI Chauffeur books the trip on the call and sends the trip sheet to your dispatcher. Anything missing is flagged for dispatch, so nothing slips.
- How does AI Chauffeur handle multiple calls at once? It answers every call at the same time, so no caller waits on hold. Each call gets its own trip sheet.
- Can it quote rides? Yes. It quotes from your rate sheet, by vehicle and time of day, in your service area, and gives one clean number. A trip your rates don't cover goes to your dispatcher to quote. The sample calls on this page use sample rates. Yours runs your rates.
- Does it work with my reservation software or dispatch software? Yes. It works with Limo Anywhere, FASTTRAK, Moovs, Livery Coach, GNet, Hudson, SantaCruz (GroundWidgets), LimoExpress, A to Z Dispatch and RideBits. With your reservation software (the $1,697 plan), the trip is written straight into your software. Where each platform stands is on the integrations page.
- How fast can it go live? Our team sets it up for you. Typical timeline is one to two weeks once we have your rates, your service area and who gets the trip sheet.
- How much does AI Chauffeur cost? AI Chauffeur is $997 a month plus a $997 one-time setup. With your reservation software, it's $1,697 a month plus a $1,697 one-time setup. The whole price is on the pricing page.
- What if you can't connect my software? If we can't connect your software within 30 days, you get a full refund within 10 days.
- Does it track flights? Yes, as an add-on. It takes the flight number on the call, and flight tracking watches the flight for your dispatcher. Priced on a quote.
- Is it set up for my company? Yes. We build it for your company: your name on the line, your fleet, your rates, your service area. Not a bot with your name typed in.
- Can I just hear it first? Yes. Call (414) 775-0019 and AI Chauffeur picks up. It is the same agent your callers would reach, with no form and no salesperson.
